en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abu Wallad, from Abu Maryam Al Ansary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘They came to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> with a man who has struck a pregnant woman with a pole of a tent, so he killed her. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> gave a choice to her guardians that they can take the wergild of five thousand Dirhams, and for negligence, a male servant or a female servant for that which was in her belly, or hand over five thousand Dirham to the guardians of the killer, and they can kill him’.
